scripts.start: cd fastapi && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3005
scripts.dev:fastapi: cd fastapi && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3005
scripts.build:fastapi: cd fastapi && uv run python -m compileall app alembic
scripts.check:fastapi: cd fastapi && uv run python -c "from app.main import app; print(app.title)"
scripts.migrate:fastapi: python -c "print('RAG schema migrations are managed by apps/admin Drizzle.')"
